items.q: What will I learn in the performance marketing course?
items.a: How to plan, launch and optimize paid campaigns on Google and Meta, and to judge every rupee spent by the results it brings, across six modules.

items.q: Does it cover both Google Ads and Meta Ads?
items.a: Yes. It is a focused Google Ads and Meta Ads course with budgeting, creatives, tracking and reporting.

items.q: Who can join the performance marketing course?
items.a: Beginners, marketers, business owners and freelancers. No earlier ads experience is needed.

items.q: How much does the performance marketing course cost?
items.a: Fill in the enquiry form or WhatsApp +91 84619 58162. We will share the fee, EMI options and batch dates.

items.q: Will I work on live campaigns?
items.a: You practise with guided campaign setups, so you learn the real workflow without risking your own money.
Yes. Every learner who completes the program receives a completion certificate, verifiable on the Verify Certificate page.

items.q: Which jobs can I get after the course?
items.a: Performance Marketer, Google Ads Specialist, Paid Social Executive and Marketing Analyst roles, or you can run ads for clients as a freelancer.

items.q: Can I run ads for my own business afterwards?
items.a: Yes. You will know how to set budgets, track conversions and read cost per lead. Practise first with our free Ad Budget & ROAS Calculator.
